senses.gloss: Dṛshadvat, a prince. § 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, ††3767 (father of Varāṅgī, the wife of Saṃyāti).

Dṛshṭipa, pl. (ºāḥ), a class of gods. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 14, †1372 (“that live upon vision,” PCR.).
